intro: Wrestling, judo and weightlifting bring Georgia Olympic medals, and rugby is hugely popular.

chapters.title: Rugby
text: Georgia, known as the Lelos, are one of the strongest rugby nations outside the top tier and have played at every Rugby World Cup since 2003.

chapters.title: Strength sports
text: Lasha Talakhadze has broken weightlifting world records and won Olympic gold. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia is a football star.

keyTerms.meaning: A traditional Georgian ball game that gave rugby fans the team's nickname.
